name: Transform Mercury Cannon / Transform Mercury Hammer

values.meaning: armor and magic resistance shred on empowered attack (Cannon Stance)
values.binNote: Sheet lists this as 'JayceStanceHtG#RangedFormShred (percent)' but the checker does not recognize a calculation of that name on JayceStanceHtG (possibly parsed differently or mis-attributed spell); citing it as [] pending clarification, though the values 0.2-0.35 match the sheet's listed array exactly.

values.meaning: bonus armor and magic resist gained in Hammer Stance
bonus magic damage on empowered attack (Hammer Stance)

mechanics.claim: Cannon Stance empowered attack reduces target's armor and magic resistance, consumed only when Jayce lands a basic attack or switches stances.
mechanics.quote: Both ''Transform'' on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when ''Jayce'' either lands a basic attack or switches stances.

mechanics.claim: The Cannon Stance empowered attack does not trigger against structures or wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

mechanics.claim: The Hammer Stance empowered attack deals bonus magic damage and can affect structures.
mechanics.quote: The ''Mercury Hammer's'' bonus damage can affect structures.

mechanics.claim: Neither empowered attack is consumed if it is parried (dodge, block, blind, Riposte).
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}, and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}).

mechanics.claim: Transformations do not count as ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Cannon Stance's resistance reduction does not apply to structures.
mechanics.quote: The resistance reduction does not apply to structures.
